planner: Poland (Gen. Zygmunt Duszyński, commander of the Polish Front, report of 1961)
source_doc: P. Piotrowski, article in Wprost, 23 Jun 2002 (history section; Danish translation titled 'Landgang i Danmark'), p.84, boxed quotation 'Polski atak atomowy' ('Fragment referatu dowódcy Frontu Polskiego gen. Zygmunta Duszyńskiego z 1961 r.'); scan on the PHP site (Danish translation: piotrowski_dk.pdf, p.3)
quote: Wskazane jest rozważenie (...) uderzeń atomowych na takie ośrodki, jak Hanower, Brunszwik, Kilonia i Brema.
notes: SECONDARY: quoted fragment of the 1961 report in a 2002 magazine article by an IPN historian; archive file not cited. A recommendation ('it is advisable to consider'), not a confirmed allocation; provenance 'plan' is generous (could be 'study'). Purpose: total disorganisation of political and economic life and panic, exploited by propaganda.
